divergence: Best canonical and relocation-strict objdiff is size-exact at 94.85714% (420 retail and 420 generated bytes). Around the count<=3 loop, retail initializes i in r19, copies it to the byte offset in r21, and materializes fn_8018D020 in r20; GC/1.3 schedules the function address first and assigns it to r21, then uses r20 for the literal-zero byte offset. This produces 3 argument mismatches, 2 inserts, 2 deletes, and 2 replacements per side. All 18 real relocations are present on each side, but fn_8018D020 HA/LO occur at offsets 224/232 retail versus 220/228 generated, so strict relocations are unequal. An explicit callback local obtained the desired persistent r20 callback and r19/r21 loop roles, but introduced an extra r0-to-r20 move and grew generated code to 424 bytes (94.666664%), so it was discarded in favor of the existing honest C.
